constraint.reason: Consistent runtime features and performance profile across services
Uniform plugin APIs and request lifecycle hooks
Single app-router behavior for TMA and CRM
Migration and client compatibility across environments
Shared component behavior and server/client boundary stability

module-level.focus: Domain services, validation policies, subscription gates, and MoveCoins invariants.

wave-level.focus: Fastify routes, auth guards, Prisma repositories, and bot integration boundaries.

phase-level.focus: TMA onboarding path, red-flag safety branch, CRM operations, and renewal flows.

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer deterministic fakes for Telegram and LLM providers, with contract snapshots for provider payloads.

Observability.redaction: Never log secrets, token payloads, raw symptoms text, or payment instrument data.

DesignSystem.ui-principles: minimal hierarchy, soft translucency, strong readability, medically calm tone
DesignSystem.glass-rules: Use controlled backdrop blur, low-opacity surfaces, and elevated cards with conservative shadow depth.
DesignSystem.accessibility-rules: Maintain WCAG-compliant contrast on text and controls; provide opaque fallback surfaces when blur/transparency is unavailable.
DesignSystem.motion-rules: Use short and subtle transitions; never block critical actions behind animation completion.

TypographyTokens.token: Inter, SF Pro Text, system-ui, sans-serif

GlassEffects.fallback-surface: Opaque elevated card with no blur

Components.component: Primary container for diagnostics, progress, and offer blocks.
Solid accent action, min-height 48px, clear pressed/disabled states.
Secondary action with glass border and hover opacity shift.
Used for period filters and category switching in dashboards.
Displays key progress and funnel metrics with icon + delta state.
Bounded campaign deadline indicator sourced from server timestamp.

InteractionStates.state: Opacity +4% or border emphasis only; no abrupt color jumps.
2px high-contrast ring on keyboard focusable controls.
Minimum 40% visual de-emphasis while preserving legibility.
Skeleton shimmer or spinner with non-blocking cancel/back action when applicable.

AccessibilityCriteria.text-contrast-min: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text.
AccessibilityCriteria.reduced-motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and disable scale/blur animations.
AccessibilityCriteria.critical-actions: Training start, renewal, support contact, and medical escalation must remain visible above first fold on core screens.

Internationalization.tma-approach: next-intl with route-level messages and lightweight useI18n wrapper hook for shared UI tokens.
Internationalization.backend-approach: Localized content selected by Accept-Language header, then user-preference locale from Users table, then default locale fallback.
Internationalization.bot-approach: Telegraf detects language_code on /start and persists locale preference for downstream API and campaign usage.

DataModelAdditions.item-1: Users table includes preferredLocale (ru/en/xx) and medicalStatus fields.
DataModelAdditions.item-2: ExerciseTranslation table keyed by (exerciseId, locale) for title/description/subtitles and localized CTA copy.
DataModelAdditions.item-3: DiagnosticQuestion and DiagnosticQuestionTranslation tables store base question metadata and localized text/options keyed by locale.
DataModelAdditions.item-4: MoveCoins transaction idempotency key uses actionId and is enforced by unique DB index.

DeliveryShape.shape: TMA and CRM on Vercel, backend on Docker/Railway, PostgreSQL as system of record, Supabase for media storage.
DeliveryShape.runtime-notes: Backend remains stateless; background workers handle notifications and retry queues.
